# Single-Master Governance — NOVA KS3 Maths

**Canonical editable input:** `00-master/nova-master.html`. This is the only document to edit for production prompts, lesson mapping and visual-plan rules.

**Derived output #1:** `00-master/NOVA-MASTER-FOR-OTHER-AI.md` — generated by running `node tools/export_master_prompts.js`. It contains the actual per-family, per-component, lesson-manifest and assessment prompts emitted by the *master's own JavaScript prompt generators*. The generated file records a SHA-256 of the source HTML, and `--check` verifies byte-for-byte parity.

**Derived output #2:** `prompts/specs/specs.json` — generated by `python prompts/specs/gen.py` directly from the canonical embedded `SPEC` data, not from nonexistent historical `s1-s6.py` files.

**Historical filename kept for compatibility:** `00-master/nova-master-updated.html` — permanently redirects to `nova-master.html`; no second editable specification.

**Locked override:** F5 fractions were already decided by the owner. Full stacked mathematical notation in NOVA Chalk; `F5/F5-FRACTION-NOTATION-LOCK.md` is authoritative. The old text labelled `fraction design TBD` is retired. This is **not** a new design decision.

**Shared-core quality:** use only actual native core/F0 helpers. No external replacement mascot artwork and no second cloned JS/CSS core are authorised by this repair.

**Never** edit generated Markdown independently. Make the change to the HTML master, export, run `--check`, review the diff, and only then include it in a local ZIP/Git update after approval.

**Historical reports:** historical `HANDOVER-v3.md` and run READMEs are kept with historical banners. Their dated claims are not updated into false new approvals; current status lives in `HANDOVER-v4.md`.
